name: Google Drive library
description: Adds mounted cloud folders (Google Drive through rclone, or any network mount) as extra library roots, with offline safety and a plan for moving watched files off the local disk.

env.name: LIBRARY_EXTRA_MOVIES_DIRS
env.description: Colon-separated movie folders on the mount (inside the container), e.g. /GDriveMovies.

env.name: LIBRARY_EXTRA_TV_DIRS
env.description: Colon-separated TV folders on the mount, e.g. /GDriveTV.

env.name: MEDIA_ROOTS
env.description: Add the same folders here so files on the drive can be played (core setting).

env.name: TIERING_MIN_AGE_DAYS
env.description: Files younger than this stay local (default 14).

env.name: TIERING_WATCHED
env.description: "any" (default): watched by one profile; "all": by every profile.
